Running into traps is literally carelessness. I know man, we have all been into that. You run around a corner, probably want revenge on some guy. Boom. You are dead. It also happens randomly, some guy cleverly places traps at his flanks. Or that one time I placed a trap directly in the "out of nowhere" area south of a specific location on a large conquest map - someone really ran into it. But - the thing I described above is a one in a million occurence. Most of the time people place it in doorways. And that is perfectly fine. If you don't run around careless you will never run into a trap. You either: 1) Throw a grenade at it 2) Shoot the trap at a safe distance 3) Wait till a friendly hits the trap and revive him/heal him 4) Simply go the other flank. It does not warrant a nerf in any way. It is a very situational tool, if you nerf it, no one will ever use it again. Same as the nerf was too much with other explosives (and keep in mind, I never used them much, but still think the nerf to them was too much)

) You can never see your own soldiers face anyway 2.) Having to render more detailed/different faces per character adds unneccesary strain to the games performance 3.) When I am in a firefight I want to be able to immedieely tell which threat I am facing 4.) Adding this in would bring absolutely nothing new to the gameplay table and would waste valuable ressources
